metadata.project_title: The Haptic Petting Zoo: Tactile Sound & Open Kinetic Hardware
metadata.notes: Direct Project costs capped at $91,200.00 under Exhibit B. Managed via cash-basis accounting to optimize sole proprietor tax liability across 2026 and 2027.

disbursements.title: Execution of Agreement & Delivery of Form W-9
disbursements.conditions: Signed Fiscal Sponsorship & Exhibit B contract, delivery of W-9 to Sponsor.
disbursements.notes: Working capital in hand for initial tooling, Q4 2026 R&D, and 11/11 bulk hardware procurement.

disbursements.title: Completion of Prototyping Phase
disbursements.conditions: Validation of core multi-sensory transit prototype (Dec 12 CymaSpace reveal), firmware architecture, and enclosure feasibility.
disbursements.notes: Targeted for January 2027 to shelter 2026 income and avoid unnecessary 2026 SE/income tax liability.

disbursements.title: Fabrication Midpoint & OCF Midpoint Interview
disbursements.conditions: 50% hardware assembly completed at Control+H, OCF mid-term progress interview.
disbursements.notes: Unlocks primary maker stipends and batch component assembly.

disbursements.title: Final Assembly & Calibration Complete
disbursements.conditions: All 10 interactive touring stations fabricated, wired, calibrated, and field-tested.
disbursements.notes: Final integration of Pelican Air transit hardware.

disbursements.title: Public Exhibition Debut
disbursements.conditions: Formal public touring premiere in Oregon with community partners.

disbursements.title: Phase 1 Fabrication Accounting Delivered to Sponsor
disbursements.conditions: Comprehensive manufacturing receipts, BOM reconciliation, and financial report submitted to Sponsor.
disbursements.notes: Final closeout of Phase 1 build budget.

budget_categories.name: Artist Fees & Project Direction
budget_categories.notes: Tracked via value-based milestone progress without public $/hr rates. Grantee paces personal draws to manage tax brackets.

budget_categories.name: Production & Fabricator Stipends
budget_categories.scope: Stipends for technicians, fabricators, soft-goods & accessibility specialists (Note 1)
budget_categories.notes: Covers maker stipends and sponsored memberships at Control+H. Will ramp heavily in Milestones 2 and 3.

budget_categories.name: Materials, Actuators & Components
budget_categories.scope: Custom PCBs, solenoids, Peltiers, vibration motors, microcontrollers, drivers
budget_categories.notes: 11/11 AliExpress bulk order allocates ~$1,450 for ESP32-S3s, ESP32-C3s, ToF sensors, and coin motors.

budget_categories.name: Tour Equipment & Transit Cases
budget_categories.scope: Ruggedized cases (Pelican/Apache equivalents) & custom internal CNC frames
budget_categories.notes: Initial procurement for 3-5 prototype transit cases (costing lower than expected due to commercial sales).

budget_categories.name: Tour Logistics, Travel & Shipping
budget_categories.scope: 2-year Oregon transit, venue support, and commercial liability insurance (Note 2)
budget_categories.notes: Includes the $200 unallocated surplus roll-in from Memo.

budget_categories.name: Media, Video & ASL Production
budget_categories.scope: High-speed macro capture, Deaf-led media, and accessible ASL documentation
budget_categories.notes: Scheduled for video documentation leading up to exhibition debut.

budget_categories.name: Hardware Maintenance Reserve
budget_categories.scope: Field repairs, spares, and wear replacement stock across 2-year tour
budget_categories.notes: Held in reserve for replacement tactile transducers during regional tour.

activities_log.title: Fiscal Sponsorship & Exhibit B Budget Finalization
activities_log.description: Reviewed and executed Fiscal Sponsorship Agreement with Jonathan Hannis (PDX Hackerspace). Finalized Exhibit B Direct Costs budget ($91,200 cap), drafted Grantee Review Memo, resolved $200 surplus to Line 5, and submitted W-9.

activities_log.title: OCF Strategic Check-in & Tour Roadmapping
activities_log.description: One-on-one strategic meeting with Oregon Community Foundation program officers. Presented project teleprompter roadmap, confirmed 2026–2028 touring vision, and discussed rural venue accessibility criteria.

activities_log.title: Corvallis Kaleidoscope & PRAx Partnership Proposal
activities_log.description: Drafted and submitted formal Deaf-led science festival proposal with Susan Anderson (CymaSpace) to Corvallis Kaleidoscope & Graand Kinetic Challenge. Proposed 'Torque, Resonance & Light' kinetic gear train + tactile frequency station and festival-wide AV accessibility audit.

activities_log.title: World Deaf Timberfest (WDT) 100-Kid STEM Workshop Scoping
activities_log.description: Conducted program negotiations with WDT administrators. Secured initial $1,000 budget (with $1,000 secondary funding pending) to lead a hands-on tactile STEM workshop for 100 Deaf youth. Structured curriculum around HAXEL tactile motor nodes to generate matching cost-share synergy with NEA grant.

activities_log.title: The Portland Tactile Dispatch Web Portal Engineering
activities_log.description: Engineered standalone, mobile-responsive broadsheet news-gazette portal (public/Projects/HapticPettingZoo/index.html). Integrated interactive canvas frequency synthesizer (5Hz–300Hz mechanoreceptor mapping), Crowd Supply Teardown 2026 video showcase, and Control+H maker onboarding.

activities_log.title: Dec 12 CymaSpace Prototype Design & 11/11 Bulk BOM Scoping
activities_log.description: Coordinated Dec 12, 2026 prototype reveal date with CymaSpace. Architected Pelican case lid computer vision tracking (ESP32-S3-CAM + VL53L1X ToF distance sensing for 3 proximity zones) modulating 5V coin vibrator critter nodes. Developed comprehensive 11/11 AliExpress bulk procurement strategy.

items.description: ESP32-S3-CAM Dev Boards (N16R8 / OV2640 / Ext Antenna)
items.intended_use: Overhead lid spatial computer vision & interactive station DSP controllers
100-kid WDT STEM tactile workshop kits + satellite critter node breakouts
3x motors per WDT STEM kit + Dec 12 CymaSpace prototype critters
Touch/proximity failover sensors for variable ambient venue lighting

items.description: AO3400A Dual/Quad N-MOSFET PWM Driver Breakout Modules
items.intended_use: Low-side PWM switching for 5V coin motors and solenoids

items.description: Tactile Bass Exciters & Bone Conduction Transducers (4Ω 25W)
items.intended_use: Deep acoustic resonance surfaces and tactile bench installations
Dynamic thermal skin sensations (hot/cold tactile modulation)
Sharp mechanical recoil and percussive tactile feedback

items.description: Heavy-Duty Waterproof Weatherproof Transit Cases (Pelican/Apache equiv)
items.intended_use: Rugged touring enclosures for Dec 12 prototype and initial 3 stations

items.description: USB-C PD Decoy Trigger Boards (5V/9V/12V) + JST-XH Connectors & Wiring
items.intended_use: Clean universal power delivery from standard USB-C battery packs

items.description: Neodymium Mounting Magnets, Silicone Dampers & Quick-Release Hardware
items.intended_use: Modular tactile plate mounting and vibration isolation
